skill.name: lightroom-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with Lightroom or needs to cull, edit, export, organize metadata, repair, migrate, or learn a Lightroom workflow. Routes each request by retained state among native image tools, file processing, Lightroom Web in My Browser, and O1-gated Lightroom desktop workflows.
skill.userDescription: Cull, edit, organize, export, and migrate photo libraries.
exampleQuestions: Create a Lightroom culling workflow for this photo shoot.
Help me organize Lightroom metadata before delivery.
Plan a safe migration of my Lightroom catalog.
